subject: Next natural stopping point: read-only Git and Google Drive backup status audit
body:
Ziggy requests this READ-ONLY status audit at your next natural stopping point, only after active production work is safely parked. Do not interrupt, pause, re-prioritize or abandon your current work to answer this note. No immediate response or app wake is requested.

1. Git: verify the actual CFA repository path, branch, local HEAD, configured upstream and remote-tracking state. Distinguish cached tracking refs from fresh verified remote evidence; record the check time and access limits. Identify the last successful push from actual available receipts/logs or remote evidence, not commit time alone. Report ahead/behind/divergence and the current uncommitted/untracked scope. Include whether important newer project outputs are outside Git coverage, without exposing secrets or private personal content.

2. Google Drive: find the latest successful backup with actual completion/remote file evidence, timestamp, backup version or manifest, and covered roots/exclusions. Configuration, a local sync-folder presence or presumed background syncing is not proof of a successful backup. Report important newer work not protected by that confirmed backup; distinguish unknown coverage from a proven gap. If the relevant Drive account/surface is unavailable, report that exact read-only limitation and do not change access or sync settings.

Scope is CHECK AND REPORT ONLY. Do not commit, push, fetch into local refs, upload, start a backup, delete, move files, change sync settings, install/connect/reconnect apps, alter credentials or accept new permission/legal prompts. Read-only status/log/remote queries and inspection of existing receipts/manifests are allowed when available. No production generation or new workers are requested.

Return your authored dated report and evidence paths/hashes plus a concise reply here when complete, explicitly separating verified Git/remote/backup facts from cached configuration, assumptions and blockers. Posted is queued only; it does not establish read, wake or audit completion.

source.verbatimUserRequest: When CFA Nova is kind of, like, past prime working, I man, I don't want to interrupt her is what I'm getting at. Can we re-examine if we're Git pushed and synced and if we're backed up on Google Drive? When she has a chance, don't have her interrupt what she's doing now, but yeah, we should check.
